limited_overlap.description: Applicants with prior earnings from 57,050 to 812,670 dollars: 1200 training rows, 90% of them with estimated enrolment propensity outside 0.02-0.98. Enrolment was rare there, so the effects for these applicants rest on few enrolled rows and on model extrapolation. 9.4% of all training rows are outside the bounds.
Applicants who did not answer the follow-up survey: their earnings are not observed, and the estimates assume non-response depends only on the covariates and enrolment.
